long_biography.plain_text:
The Menu Partners brings together fresh-food sourcing, preparation and distribution for British hospitality customers. Nigel Harris formed the venture with wholesaler Jason Tanner, linking a national supply network to Absolute Taste, the event caterer Nigel had acquired. His continuing stake gives him an active interest in both the distribution business and its catering arm.

That combination drew on a longer family history. Nigel's father John and Bill Hawkins began a mobile produce business that became the foundation for Fresh Direct. Nigel and his brother Colin held ownership interests as he led the company's expansion into a major foodservice wholesaler. A combination with Bain Capital-backed businesses preceded its incorporation into Sysco's British operation.
